reason: A Git visualization workbench embedded in the DeepSeek Harness conversation interface, providing commit graphs, branch filtering, diffs, working-tree status, and documented Git operations.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话界面中可视化查看和管理 Git 仓库，支持提交图谱、分支筛选、代码 Diff、工作区改动及常用 Git 操作。
summaries.en: A Git visualization workbench for the DeepSeek Harness conversation interface with commit graphs, branch filtering, code diffs, working-tree changes, and common Git operations.

capabilities: Displays Git commit history, branches, commit details, file diffs, and working-tree status
Reads repository and workspace Git data
Performs repository operations including checkout, merge, reset, cherry-pick, stash, and tag creation
Embeds Git views and an unsaved-changes panel in the host conversation interface
